name: Swift Quiver

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: Fire two extra shots each turn as a Bonus Action with magically supplied ammunition.
text: When you cast it and as a Bonus Action on later turns, you make two attacks with a weapon that fires Arrows or Bolts. The spell makes the ammunition, which vanishes after it hits or misses.
